players.name: Carson Schwesinger
players.comment: Schwesinger (wrist) does not have an injury designation against the Texans on Sunday.

players.name: Quincy Williams
players.comment: Williams (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against Houston.

players.name: Denzel Ward
players.comment: Ward (quadriceps) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Texans.

players.name: Ronnie Hickman
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Myles Harden
players.comment: Harden recorded five tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks, and one pass defense during the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints in Week 9.

players.name: Andre Szmyt
players.comment: Szmyt went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to New Orleans.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.comment: Boston (toe) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Texans, Kelsey Russo of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jerry Jeudy
players.comment: Jeudy caught two of four targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.comment: The Browns announced Wednesday that Watson (concussion) will start Sunday's game against the Texans, Kelsey Russo of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.comment: Fannin (groin) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Texans, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.comment: Running backs coach Duce Staley said Saturday that Judkins' lower snap count against the Saints in Week 9 was "situational football," Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

players.name: Will Anderson Jr.
players.comment: Anderson (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

players.name: Danielle Hunter
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Azeez Al-Shaair
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Reed Blankenship
players.comment: Blankenship (concussion/hand) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Browns.

players.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
players.comment: Fairbairn went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made all five of his PATs during Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.comment: Dell (hand) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Browns, while teammate Marvin Harrison (hamstring) has been ruled out.

players.name: Keylan Rutledge
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Dalton Schultz
players.comment: Schultz caught two of four targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.comment: Marks will be the Texans' lead back against the Browns on Sunday after David Montgomery (groin) was ruled out for that contest.
